title: Did an AI Music App Just Snitch on the Song of the Summer?
excerpt: Fenix Flexin’s hit song “Rubberz” has hip-hop fans arguing over whether it was generated by AI. Some say they have proof it’s machine-made, but will anyone care?
content_html:
There is no such thing as a universal “song of the summer” anymore, but if you’re into rap music, Fenix Flexin’s “Rubberz” is a pretty strong contender.

Officially released in June, it currently sits at No. 58 in the Billboard Hot 100 and has a music video with 7 million views. Lyrically, it’s got everything you’d want: boasts about cash and jewelry, and bars that work as a double entendre for braggadocio and depression.

But there are two interesting twists to “Rubberz.” First, it isn’t a rap song at all; it’s a synth-pop tune that would be at home in a moody ’80s playlist. Also, since it dropped, it’s been the focus of accusations that it was completely or partially AI-generated.

The argument reached a peak this weekend after an independent music producer claimed he’d figured out not only how Fenix had made “Rubberz” but that the rapper’s labelmate, Tyga, also seems to have used a little-known generative AI music app to create some ’80s-themed tunes of his own.

And now, the creators of that same AI music app have effectively snitched on both: The service’s new built-in detector is now flagging the songs made by both Fenix and Tyga as likely AI-generated.

This may finally settle the argument fans have been having all summer. It won’t settle the one they’re about to start.

Tune Up

People were suspicious of Fenix from the beginning; “Rubberz” is not only an unusual genre shift for the artist, it also doesn’t sound like his voice in the song.

Fenix Flexin grew up in East Hollywood, and he sounds like it, and when he debuted as part of the group Shoreline Mafia in the late 2010s, you could always recognize which bars were his because of his somewhat nasally, congested voice. The voice on his June 5 release of “Rubberz,” however, is completely unrecognizable. It’s a lot brighter and crisper, and the accent sounds closer to a very chipper Morrissey.

Both he and the credited producer, Purps on the Beat, have denied using AI at every turn. Fenix told Channel 5 that he “freestyled” the lyrics, and in the comments of an On the Radar performance, he replied to people accusing him of using AI: "No sirrrrrrr, recorded same as all music I do! Only difference is auto-tune reverb and me using my fake uk accent lol."

Not everyone bought his explanation, but there was no proof otherwise. As the summer continued, music media debated whether “Rubberz” had been AI-generated. But none of the well-known AI music detectors flagged it, Fenix denied it, and the song continued to rack up plays. Fans had no choice but to get comfortable with the question being unresolved.

Then, things shifted suddenly. On Thursday, a music producer named Medasin posted a video claiming he’d figured out how Fenix used AI to make the track.

It wasn’t Suno, or Udio, the two most prominent generative AI tools for making music. Instead, Medasin says, Flexin had used a lesser-known app called Treblo. Medasin breaks down his accusation methodically: First, he points out that the app used to be called Sonauto until two days before “Rubberz” was released. And then he shows a screen cap of one of Fenix’s old Instagram Stories teasing his new ’80s sound. A freeze-frame and zoom reveals that a filename being shown on screen has the suffix “Sonauto.mp3.”

But the most compelling accusation comes when Medasin shows how he was able to use Treblo to create a very similar track. By using tags like “80s synthwave” and prompting the app to write lyrics about a “rapper lifestyle,” Medasin got a similar-sounding song. The lyrics even bear more than a passing resemblance to “Rubberz.”

For example, Medasin’s prompt got him the lyrics “Diamond chains hanging heavy”; “Rubberz” has “Now I bought a heavy diamond chain.” Medasin’s generated song gave him “I see your face in the champagne bubbles”; Fenix’ song has “Still seeing your face in the glass.” Both songs feature some permutation of “pockets thick,” both mention “plastic smiles.”

“There's just way too many coincidences,” Medasin said in an interview with WIRED. “It is just a mathematical impossibility that he did not use Treblo.”

This all made me curious, though. Would Treblo allow me to re-create a “Rubberz”-style song? It turns out: yes.

By entering tags like “80s synthwave” and asking it to make rap lyrics, I got not only a similar sound but similar lyrical structures.

In my first try, I generated a song (you can hear it here) with the couplet “Rings on every finger / Leather seats and cedar scent linger,” an almost mirror duplicate of the “Rubberz” line “Gold rings on my fingers / Still your perfume lingers.” I continued to generate songs. Even with slight variations, any time I combined an “80s” tag with a prompt for “rap lyrics,” I got similar results.

Whereas ChatGPT seems to like goblins, em dashes, and “it’s not X, it’s Y” constructions, Treblo’s engine seems to be obsessed with “finger/linger” rhyme pairs, talking about rings and glass and pockets, and song constructions in which there is a thematic transition from night into day.

Medasin says his Treblo revelation happened a month ago, but he kept it quiet; he figured some journalist would do the legwork of connecting the dots for the public. This did happen on a smaller scale, perhaps most thoroughly on an AI music news site called Zinstrel, but it never really broke through. Medasin’s video was the first to capture attention.

As Thursday went on, it seemed that Medasin had struck a nerve with his video accusation. That afternoon, Fenix posted a video on his Instagram page of what he said was the original project file for “Rubberz.” If authentic, this would serve as proof that the song was not AI; that “Rubberz” had been created from scratch in a studio.

But music producers immediately jumped into the comments, with many claiming that the project file being shown looked suspiciously like someone had just taken an existing song and used a “stem separator” to extract a full song into rudimentary components like bass and drums; which would point back to it just being an AI song that they couldn’t create.

Hours later, Fenix deleted the post. Neither he nor Purps on the Beat have addressed the “evidence” video since, or why it was taken down. Requests for comment sent to both by WIRED went unanswered.

Then, another one. Two days later, on Saturday, Medasin dropped another video, this time alleging that Tyga’s new $TARFACE project is also at least partially using Treblo. He starts with some loose connections: videos were posted on social media of Tyga and Fenix together, both are on the same label, the same sudden rapper-to-’80s crooner pathway. But also, he ran a Tyga song in a new AI music detector a friend is developing, and it was flagged as AI.

But it’s more convincing to hear directly from Treblo itself.

"Someone appears to have used our model to find a sound that millions of people connected with,” Treblo cofounder Ryan Tremblay said when asked for comment, “and that's exciting.”

Treblo had not previously spoken to Tyga or Fenix, Tremblay says, and the company wasn’t “even aware [“Rubberz”] existed until after it hit the Hot 100.”

Asking Treblo about individual songs might not be necessary in the future. Late Sunday night, Treblo published a page titled “Was This Made With Treblo?” In short, it’s a Treblo music detector. “We also think listeners should know what they're hearing,” a blog post explains, describig it as a tool that is “tuned to detect songs made with Treblo with little to no modification.”

Sure enough, feeding “Rubberz” into the tool returns a result of “Very likely Treblo.” Running a track that Tyga dropped in early July returns a result of “Likely Treblo.”

The rate of false positives, Treblo’s site says, is under one in 10,000; a fraction of a percent. The detector’s efficacy has not been independently reviewed, but Treblo has released the code under an open source license so anyone can inspect it and test it.

Requests sent by WIRED to Tyga’s label for comment were not returned.

Slop or Not

The timing of all this coincides with a trend of platforms making gestures toward AI-generated content. The same day that Medasin posted his first video, LinkedIn rolled out a new feature: a “seems like AI” button that allows users to flag AI slop in posts. Two weeks ago, Substack released a new feature that purports to detect AI-written newsletters. Tidal has blocked monetization of AI-generated music, and while Spotify doesn’t have an AI tagging feature, there’s a crowdsourced tracker where you can report slop to other listeners.

The proliferation of image and video generators over the past few years has provoked worries about the spread of machine-made content and misinformation. A bipartisan AI Labeling Act in the US Senate has been suggested as a partial solution: forcing platforms to visibly label AI-generated content so that it would be clear whether online content is real or not. “People deserve to know,” one senator told Politico.

What we should have anticipated was that there would be people who don’t want to know. People who would get angry if you ruin the fantasy.

The comment section of Medasin’s first video is full of this: people who say they like “Rubberz” anyway, that they don’t care that the song is AI. That AI is the future and that Medasin is just jealous that Fenix thought of it first.

Medasin says he wasn’t surprised by the reaction. He admits he liked the song when he first heard it and still somewhat enjoys it in an ironic sort of way. “It's catchy, and it was stuck in my head for a fucking month,” he says. So why risk a bunch of people looking at him like he’s the guy in the conspiracy board meme?

Ultimately, Medasin says, he thinks there can be a place for AI in music, even if he doesn’t like it personally. But he wants artists to tell the truth, so listeners can decide for themselves.

“This is, like, a critical moment in music history,” Medasin tells WIRED, “and I have very, very deep respect and love for the journey of musicians and humans and human experience being celebrated and present in music.” He decries anyone who would be deceptive about that and profit off of it. “It is unethical to me on a very spiritual level,” he says.

Music fans spent half the summer arguing over whether a surprise hit song was synthetic. It looks like they have an answer. Now they just have to decide how much it matters to them.

sentences.zh: 周四，一位名叫 Medasin 的音乐制作人发布了一段视频，声称他已经弄清楚 Fenix 如何使用人工智能来制作这首歌曲。

blocks.html_en: It wasn’t Suno, or Udio, the two most prominent generative AI tools for making music. Instead, Medasin says, Flexin had used a lesser-known app called Treblo. Medasin breaks down his accusation methodically: First, he points out that the app used to be called Sonauto until two days before “Rubberz” was released. And then he shows a screen cap of one of Fenix’s old Instagram Stories teasing his new ’80s sound. A freeze-frame and zoom reveals that a filename being shown on screen has the suffix “Sonauto.mp3.”

sentences.en: It wasn’t Suno, or Udio, the two most prominent generative AI tools for making music.
sentences.zh: 它不是 Suno 或 Udio 这两个最著名的音乐制作人工智能工具。

sentences.en: Instead, Medasin says, Flexin had used a lesser-known app called Treblo.
sentences.zh: Medasin 表示，Flexin 使用的是一款不太知名的应用程序，名为 Treblo。

sentences.en: Medasin breaks down his accusation methodically: First, he points out that the app used to be called Sonauto until two days before “Rubberz” was released.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛有条不紊地分解了他的指控：首先，他指出该应用程序在“Rubberz”发布前两天之前一直被称为 Sonauto。

sentences.en: And then he shows a screen cap of one of Fenix’s old Instagram Stories teasing his new ’80s sound.
sentences.zh: 然后他展示了 Fenix 的一个旧 Instagram 故事的屏幕截图，戏弄他的 80 年代新声音。

sentences.en: A freeze-frame and zoom reveals that a filename being shown on screen has the suffix “Sonauto.mp3.”
sentences.zh: 定格和缩放显示屏幕上显示的文件名具有后缀“Sonauto.mp3”。

blocks.html_en: But the most compelling accusation comes when Medasin shows how he was able to use Treblo to create a very similar track. By using tags like “80s synthwave” and prompting the app to write lyrics about a “rapper lifestyle,” Medasin got a similar-sounding song. The lyrics even bear more than a passing resemblance to “Rubberz.”

sentences.en: But the most compelling accusation comes when Medasin shows how he was able to use Treblo to create a very similar track.
sentences.zh: 但最引人注目的指控是当 Medasin 展示他如何使用 Treblo 创作出非常相似的曲目时。

sentences.en: By using tags like “80s synthwave” and prompting the app to write lyrics about a “rapper lifestyle,” Medasin got a similar-sounding song.
sentences.zh: 通过使用“80 年代合成波”等标签并提示应用程序编写有关“说唱歌手生活方式”的歌词，梅达辛获得了一首听起来类似的歌曲。

sentences.en: The lyrics even bear more than a passing resemblance to “Rubberz.”
sentences.zh: 歌词甚至与《Rubberz》有非常相似之处。

blocks.html_en: For example, Medasin’s prompt got him the lyrics “Diamond chains hanging heavy”; “Rubberz” has “Now I bought a heavy diamond chain.” Medasin’s generated song gave him “I see your face in the champagne bubbles”; Fenix’ song has “Still seeing your face in the glass.” Both songs feature some permutation of “pockets thick,” both mention “plastic smiles.”

sentences.en: For example, Medasin’s prompt got him the lyrics “Diamond chains hanging heavy”; “Rubberz” has “Now I bought a heavy diamond chain.”
sentences.zh: 例如，梅达辛的提示让他得到了歌词“钻石链悬挂沉重”； “Rubberz”有“现在我买了一条沉重的钻石链。”

sentences.en: Medasin’s generated song gave him “I see your face in the champagne bubbles”; Fenix’ song has “Still seeing your face in the glass.”
sentences.zh: 梅达辛生成的歌曲给了他“我在香槟气泡中看到你的脸”；菲尼克斯的歌曲有“仍然在玻璃中看到你的脸”。

sentences.en: Both songs feature some permutation of “pockets thick,” both mention “plastic smiles.”
sentences.zh: 这两首歌都以“口袋厚”的一些排列为特色，都提到了“塑料微笑”。

blocks.html_en: “There's just way too many coincidences,” Medasin said in an interview with WIRED. “It is just a mathematical impossibility that he did not use Treblo.”

sentences.en: “There's just way too many coincidences,” Medasin said in an interview with WIRED.
sentences.zh: “巧合实在是太多了，”梅达辛在接受《连线》采访时说道。

sentences.en: “It is just a mathematical impossibility that he did not use Treblo.”
sentences.zh: “他没有使用 Treblo，这在数学上是不可能的。”

blocks.html_en: This all made me curious, though. Would Treblo allow me to re-create a “Rubberz”-style song? It turns out: yes.

sentences.en: This all made me curious, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这一切都让我感到好奇。

sentences.en: Would Treblo allow me to re-create a “Rubberz”-style song?
sentences.zh: Treblo 会允许我重新创作一首“Rubberz”风格的歌曲吗？

sentences.en: It turns out: yes.
sentences.zh: 事实证明：是的。

blocks.html_en: By entering tags like “80s synthwave” and asking it to make rap lyrics, I got not only a similar sound but similar lyrical structures.

sentences.en: By entering tags like “80s synthwave” and asking it to make rap lyrics, I got not only a similar sound but similar lyrical structures.
sentences.zh: 通过输入“80 年代合成波”等标签并要求它制作说唱歌词，我不仅得到了相似的声音，而且得到了相似的抒情结构。

blocks.html_en: In my first try, I generated a song (you can hear it here) with the couplet “Rings on every finger / Leather seats and cedar scent linger,” an almost mirror duplicate of the “Rubberz” line “Gold rings on my fingers / Still your perfume lingers.” I continued to generate songs. Even with slight variations, any time I combined an “80s” tag with a prompt for “rap lyrics,” I got similar results.

sentences.en: In my first try, I generated a song (you can hear it here) with the couplet “Rings on every finger / Leather seats and cedar scent linger,” an almost mirror duplicate of the “Rubberz” line “Gold rings on my fingers / Still your perfume lingers.”
sentences.zh: 在我的第一次尝试中，我创作了一首带有对联的歌曲（你可以在这里听到）“每个手指上都有戒指/皮革座椅和雪松香味萦绕”，几乎是“Rubberz”台词“我手指上的金戒指/仍然你的香水挥之不去”的镜像复制品。

sentences.en: I continued to generate songs.
sentences.zh: 我继续创作歌曲。

sentences.en: Even with slight variations, any time I combined an “80s” tag with a prompt for “rap lyrics,” I got similar results.
sentences.zh: 即使有细微的变化，每当我将“80 年代”标签与“说唱歌词”提示结合起来时，我都会得到类似的结果。

blocks.html_en: Whereas ChatGPT seems to like goblins, em dashes, and “it’s not X, it’s Y” constructions, Treblo’s engine seems to be obsessed with “finger/linger” rhyme pairs, talking about rings and glass and pockets, and song constructions in which there is a thematic transition from night into day.

sentences.en: Whereas ChatGPT seems to like goblins, em dashes, and “it’s not X, it’s Y” constructions, Treblo’s engine seems to be obsessed with “finger/linger” rhyme pairs, talking about rings and glass and pockets, and song constructions in which there is a thematic transition from night into day.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT 似乎喜欢妖精、破折号和“这不是 X，这是 Y”结构，而 Treblo 的引擎似乎痴迷于“手指/徘徊”韵律对，谈论戒指、玻璃和口袋，以及从夜晚到白天主题过渡的歌曲结构。

blocks.html_en: Medasin says his Treblo revelation happened a month ago, but he kept it quiet; he figured some journalist would do the legwork of connecting the dots for the public. This did happen on a smaller scale, perhaps most thoroughly on an AI music news site called Zinstrel, but it never really broke through. Medasin’s video was the first to capture attention.

sentences.en: Medasin says his Treblo revelation happened a month ago, but he kept it quiet; he figured some journalist would do the legwork of connecting the dots for the public.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛说，他的特雷布洛事件发生在一个月前，但他保持沉默。他认为有些记者会为公众做一些将这些点串联起来的跑腿工作。

sentences.en: This did happen on a smaller scale, perhaps most thoroughly on an AI music news site called Zinstrel, but it never really broke through.
sentences.zh: 这种情况确实在较小的规模上发生过，也许最彻底的是在一个名为 Zinstrel 的人工智能音乐新闻网站上，但它从未真正取得突破。

sentences.en: Medasin’s video was the first to capture attention.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛的视频最先引起了人们的注意。

blocks.html_en: As Thursday went on, it seemed that Medasin had struck a nerve with his video accusation. That afternoon, Fenix posted a video on his Instagram page of what he said was the original project file for “Rubberz.” If authentic, this would serve as proof that the song was not AI; that “Rubberz” had been created from scratch in a studio.

sentences.en: As Thursday went on, it seemed that Medasin had struck a nerve with his video accusation.
sentences.zh: 随着周四的过去，梅达辛的视频指控似乎触动了人们的神经。

sentences.en: That afternoon, Fenix posted a video on his Instagram page of what he said was the original project file for “Rubberz.”
sentences.zh: 那天下午，菲尼克斯在他的 Instagram 页面上发布了一段视频，他说这是“Rubberz”的原始项目文件。

sentences.en: If authentic, this would serve as proof that the song was not AI; that “Rubberz” had been created from scratch in a studio.
sentences.zh: 如果是真的，这将证明这首歌不是人工智能； “Rubberz”是在工作室里从头开始创作的。

blocks.html_en: But music producers immediately jumped into the comments, with many claiming that the project file being shown looked suspiciously like someone had just taken an existing song and used a “stem separator” to extract a full song into rudimentary components like bass and drums; which would point back to it just being an AI song that they couldn’t create.

sentences.en: But music producers immediately jumped into the comments, with many claiming that the project file being shown looked suspiciously like someone had just taken an existing song and used a “stem separator” to extract a full song into rudimentary components like bass and drums; which would point back to it just being an AI song that they couldn’t create.
sentences.zh: 但音乐制作人立即发表了评论，许多人声称所显示的项目文件看起来可疑，就像有人刚刚拍摄了一首现有歌曲，并使用“茎分离器”将整首歌曲提取为贝斯和鼓等基本组件；这表明这只是一首他们无法创作的人工智能歌曲。

blocks.html_en: Hours later, Fenix deleted the post. Neither he nor Purps on the Beat have addressed the “evidence” video since, or why it was taken down. Requests for comment sent to both by WIRED went unanswered.

sentences.en: Hours later, Fenix deleted the post.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，菲尼克斯删除了该帖子。

sentences.en: Neither he nor Purps on the Beat have addressed the “evidence” video since, or why it was taken down.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，他和 Purps on the Beat 都没有提及这段“证据”视频，也没有提及该视频被删除的原因。

sentences.en: Requests for comment sent to both by WIRED went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 《连线》杂志向两人发送置评请求，但均未得到答复。

blocks.html_en: Then, another one. Two days later, on Saturday, Medasin dropped another video, this time alleging that Tyga’s new $TARFACE project is also at least partially using Treblo. He starts with some loose connections: videos were posted on social media of Tyga and Fenix together, both are on the same label, the same sudden rapper-to-’80s crooner pathway. But also, he ran a Tyga song in a new AI music detector a friend is developing, and it was flagged as AI.

sentences.en: Then, another one.
sentences.zh: 然后，再来一张。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Saturday, Medasin dropped another video, this time alleging that Tyga’s new $TARFACE project is also at least partially using Treblo.
sentences.zh: 两天后的周六，Medasin 发布了另一个视频，这次声称 Tyga 的新 $TARFACE 项目也至少部分使用了 Treblo。

sentences.en: He starts with some loose connections: videos were posted on social media of Tyga and Fenix together, both are on the same label, the same sudden rapper-to-’80s crooner pathway.
sentences.zh: 他从一些松散的联系开始：Tyga 和 Fenix 一起在社交媒体上发布了视频，两者都属于同一厂牌，同样是从说唱歌手到 80 年代歌手的路径。

sentences.en: But also, he ran a Tyga song in a new AI music detector a friend is developing, and it was flagged as AI.
sentences.zh: 而且，他还在朋友正在开发的新人工智能音乐检测器中运行了一首 Tyga 歌曲，并且它被标记为人工智能。

blocks.html_en: But it’s more convincing to hear directly from Treblo itself.

sentences.en: But it’s more convincing to hear directly from Treblo itself.
sentences.zh: 但直接听 Treblo 本人的说法更有说服力。

blocks.html_en: "Someone appears to have used our model to find a sound that millions of people connected with,” Treblo cofounder Ryan Tremblay said when asked for comment, “and that's exciting.”

sentences.en: "Someone appears to have used our model to find a sound that millions of people connected with,” Treblo cofounder Ryan Tremblay said when asked for comment, “and that's exciting.”
sentences.zh: Treblo 联合创始人瑞安·特伦布莱 (Ryan Tremblay) 在被问及置评时表示：“似乎有人使用我们的模型找到了一种让数百万人产生共鸣的声音，这令人兴奋。”

blocks.html_en: Treblo had not previously spoken to Tyga or Fenix, Tremblay says, and the company wasn’t “even aware [“Rubberz”] existed until after it hit the Hot 100.”

sentences.en: Treblo had not previously spoken to Tyga or Fenix, Tremblay says, and the company wasn’t “even aware [“Rubberz”] existed until after it hit the Hot 100.”
sentences.zh: 特雷布利表示，特雷布洛此前并未与 Tyga 或 Fenix 进行过交谈，该公司“甚至在进入热门 100 强之前才意识到 [“Rubberz”] 的存在。”

blocks.html_en: Asking Treblo about individual songs might not be necessary in the future. Late Sunday night, Treblo published a page titled “Was This Made With Treblo?” In short, it’s a Treblo music detector. “We also think listeners should know what they're hearing,” a blog post explains, describig it as a tool that is “tuned to detect songs made with Treblo with little to no modification.”

sentences.en: Asking Treblo about individual songs might not be necessary in the future.
sentences.zh: 将来可能不需要向 Treblo 询问个别歌曲的情况。

sentences.en: Late Sunday night, Treblo published a page titled “Was This Made With Treblo?”
sentences.zh: 周日深夜，Treblo 发布了一个名为“这是用 Treblo 制作的吗？”的页面。

sentences.en: In short, it’s a Treblo music detector.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，它是一个 Treblo 音乐探测器。

sentences.en: “We also think listeners should know what they're hearing,” a blog post explains, describig it as a tool that is “tuned to detect songs made with Treblo with little to no modification.”
sentences.zh: “我们还认为听众应该知道他们听到的是什么，”一篇博客文章解释道，并将其描述为一种“经过调整以检测用 Treblo 制作的歌曲，几乎不需要任何修改”的工具。

blocks.html_en: Sure enough, feeding “Rubberz” into the tool returns a result of “Very likely Treblo.” Running a track that Tyga dropped in early July returns a result of “Likely Treblo.”

sentences.en: Sure enough, feeding “Rubberz” into the tool returns a result of “Very likely Treblo.”
sentences.zh: 果然，将“Rubberz”输入该工具会返回“很可能是 Treblo”的结果。

sentences.en: Running a track that Tyga dropped in early July returns a result of “Likely Treblo.”
sentences.zh: 运行 Tyga 在 7 月初放弃的曲目会返回“可能是 Treblo”的结果。

blocks.html_en: The rate of false positives, Treblo’s site says, is under one in 10,000; a fraction of a percent. The detector’s efficacy has not been independently reviewed, but Treblo has released the code under an open source license so anyone can inspect it and test it.

sentences.en: The rate of false positives, Treblo’s site says, is under one in 10,000; a fraction of a percent.
sentences.zh: Treblo 网站称，误报率低于万分之一；百分之几的一小部分。

sentences.en: The detector’s efficacy has not been independently reviewed, but Treblo has released the code under an open source license so anyone can inspect it and test it.
sentences.zh: 该探测器的功效尚未经过独立审查，但 Treblo 已根据开源许可证发布了代码，以便任何人都可以检查和测试它。

blocks.html_en: Requests sent by WIRED to Tyga’s label for comment were not returned.

sentences.en: Requests sent by WIRED to Tyga’s label for comment were not returned.
sentences.zh: 《连线》杂志向 Tyga 厂牌发出置评请求，但未得到回复。

blocks.html_en: Slop or Not

sentences.en: Slop or Not
sentences.zh: 是否有溢出

blocks.html_en: The timing of all this coincides with a trend of platforms making gestures toward AI-generated content. The same day that Medasin posted his first video, LinkedIn rolled out a new feature: a “seems like AI” button that allows users to flag AI slop in posts. Two weeks ago, Substack released a new feature that purports to detect AI-written newsletters. Tidal has blocked monetization of AI-generated music, and while Spotify doesn’t have an AI tagging feature, there’s a crowdsourced tracker where you can report slop to other listeners.

sentences.en: The timing of all this coincides with a trend of platforms making gestures toward AI-generated content.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切的时机与平台向人工智能生成内容做出姿态的趋势相吻合。

sentences.en: The same day that Medasin posted his first video, LinkedIn rolled out a new feature: a “seems like AI” button that allows users to flag AI slop in posts.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛发布第一个视频的同一天，LinkedIn 推出了一项新功能：“看起来像人工智能”按钮，允许用户在帖子中标记人工智能的错误。

sentences.en: Two weeks ago, Substack released a new feature that purports to detect AI-written newsletters.
sentences.zh: 两周前，Substack 发布了一项新功能，旨在检测人工智能撰写的时事通讯。

sentences.en: Tidal has blocked monetization of AI-generated music, and while Spotify doesn’t have an AI tagging feature, there’s a crowdsourced tracker where you can report slop to other listeners.
sentences.zh: Tidal 阻止了人工智能生成的音乐的货币化，虽然 Spotify 没有人工智能标签功能，但有一个众包跟踪器，你可以在其中向其他听众报告溢出情况。

blocks.html_en: The proliferation of image and video generators over the past few years has provoked worries about the spread of machine-made content and misinformation. A bipartisan AI Labeling Act in the US Senate has been suggested as a partial solution: forcing platforms to visibly label AI-generated content so that it would be clear whether online content is real or not. “People deserve to know,” one senator told Politico.

sentences.en: The proliferation of image and video generators over the past few years has provoked worries about the spread of machine-made content and misinformation.
sentences.zh: 过去几年图像和视频生成器的激增引发了人们对机器制作内容和错误信息传播的担忧。

sentences.en: A bipartisan AI Labeling Act in the US Senate has been suggested as a partial solution: forcing platforms to visibly label AI-generated content so that it would be clear whether online content is real or not.
sentences.zh: 美国参议院的两党人工智能标签法案被建议作为部分解决方案：迫使平台对人工智能生成的内容进行明显的标记，以便清楚在线内容是否真实。

sentences.en: “People deserve to know,” one senator told Politico.
sentences.zh: “人们应该知道，”一位参议员告诉 Politico。

blocks.html_en: What we should have anticipated was that there would be people who don’t want to know. People who would get angry if you ruin the fantasy.

sentences.en: What we should have anticipated was that there would be people who don’t want to know.
sentences.zh: 我们应该预料到会有人不想知道。

sentences.en: People who would get angry if you ruin the fantasy.
sentences.zh: 如果你破坏了幻想，人们就会生气。

blocks.html_en: The comment section of Medasin’s first video is full of this: people who say they like “Rubberz” anyway, that they don’t care that the song is AI. That AI is the future and that Medasin is just jealous that Fenix thought of it first.

sentences.en: The comment section of Medasin’s first video is full of this: people who say they like “Rubberz” anyway, that they don’t care that the song is AI.
sentences.zh: Medasin 第一个视频的评论部分充满了这样的内容：人们说他们无论如何都喜欢“Rubberz”，他们不在乎这首歌是 AI。

sentences.en: That AI is the future and that Medasin is just jealous that Fenix thought of it first.
sentences.zh: 人工智能是未来，梅达辛只是嫉妒菲尼克斯首先想到了它。

blocks.html_en: Medasin says he wasn’t surprised by the reaction. He admits he liked the song when he first heard it and still somewhat enjoys it in an ironic sort of way. “It's catchy, and it was stuck in my head for a fucking month,” he says. So why risk a bunch of people looking at him like he’s the guy in the conspiracy board meme?

sentences.en: Medasin says he wasn’t surprised by the reaction.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛说他对这种反应并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: He admits he liked the song when he first heard it and still somewhat enjoys it in an ironic sort of way.
sentences.zh: 他承认，当他第一次听到这首歌时，他就喜欢这首歌，并且仍然以一种讽刺的方式享受它。

sentences.en: “It's catchy, and it was stuck in my head for a fucking month,” he says.
sentences.zh: “它很吸引人，它在我脑子里盘旋了一个月，”他说。

sentences.en: So why risk a bunch of people looking at him like he’s the guy in the conspiracy board meme?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么要冒着一群人看着他的风险，就像他是阴谋委员会模因中的那个人一样呢？

blocks.html_en: Ultimately, Medasin says, he thinks there can be a place for AI in music, even if he doesn’t like it personally. But he wants artists to tell the truth, so listeners can decide for themselves.

sentences.en: Ultimately, Medasin says, he thinks there can be a place for AI in music, even if he doesn’t like it personally.
sentences.zh: 梅达辛说，最终，他认为人工智能在音乐中可以占有一席之地，即使他个人并不喜欢它。

sentences.en: But he wants artists to tell the truth, so listeners can decide for themselves.
sentences.zh: 但他希望艺术家说出真相，以便听众可以自己决定。

blocks.html_en: “This is, like, a critical moment in music history,” Medasin tells WIRED, “and I have very, very deep respect and love for the journey of musicians and humans and human experience being celebrated and present in music.” He decries anyone who would be deceptive about that and profit off of it. “It is unethical to me on a very spiritual level,” he says.

sentences.en: “This is, like, a critical moment in music history,” Medasin tells WIRED, “and I have very, very deep respect and love for the journey of musicians and humans and human experience being celebrated and present in music.”
sentences.zh: “这就像音乐史上的一个关键时刻，”梅达辛告诉《连线》杂志，“我对音乐家和人类的旅程以及在音乐中得到庆祝和呈现的人类经历怀有非常非常深的尊重和热爱。”

sentences.en: He decries anyone who would be deceptive about that and profit off of it.

content_html_zh:
现在已经不存在通用的“夏日之歌”了，但如果您喜欢说唱音乐，Fenix Flexin 的“Rubberz”是一个相当有力的竞争者。

该歌曲于 6 月正式发行，目前在 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上排名第 58 位，音乐视频观看次数达 700 万次。 从歌词上讲，这里有你想要的一切：吹嘘现金和珠宝，以及充当吹牛和抑郁的双关语的酒吧。

但“Rubberz”有两个有趣的转折。 首先，这根本不是一首说唱歌曲；它是一首说唱歌曲。这是一首合成流行音乐，适合 80 年代喜怒无常的播放列表。 此外，自从它被删除以来，它一直是指责它完全或部分由人工智能生成的焦点。

本周末，争论达到了顶峰，一位独立音乐制作人声称他不仅弄清楚了 Fenix 是如何制作“Rubberz”的，而且这位说唱歌手的厂牌伙伴 Tyga 似乎也使用了一款鲜为人知的生成式 AI 音乐应用程序来创作一些自己的 80 年代主题歌曲。

现在，同一个人工智能音乐应用程序的创建者实际上已经告密了这两件事：该服务的新内置检测器现在将 Fenix 和 Tyga 制作的歌曲标记为可能是人工智能生成的。

这可能最终解决了球迷整个夏天的争论。 这不会解决他们即将开始的事情。

调整

人们从一开始就对菲尼克斯抱有怀疑；对于艺术家来说，“Rubberz”不仅是一种不同寻常的流派转变，而且听起来也不像他在歌曲中的声音。

Fenix Flexin 在东好莱坞长大，他的声音也很像，当他在 2010 年代末作为 Shoreline Mafia 组合首次亮相时，你总能认出哪些酒吧是他的，因为他的声音有点鼻音、拥挤。 然而，他 6 月 5 日发行的《Rubberz》中的声音却完全无法辨认。 它更加明亮、清脆，而且口音听起来更接近于非常爽快的莫里西。

他和著名制作人 Purps on the Beat 都否认每次都使用人工智能。 菲尼克斯告诉第五频道，他“自由创作”了歌词，在 On the Radar 表演的评论中，他回复了那些指责他使用人工智能的人：“不，sirrrrrrr，我录制的所有音乐都一样！ 唯一的区别是自动调谐混响和我使用我的假英国口音哈哈。”

并不是所有人都相信他的解释，但也没有证据证明他的解释是正确的。 随着夏天的继续，音乐媒体争论“Rubberz”是否是人工智能生成的。 但没有一个著名的人工智能音乐检测器标记它，菲尼克斯否认了它，这首歌继续被播放。 粉丝们别无选择，只能接受这个悬而未决的问题。

然后，事情突然发生了转变。 周四，一位名叫 Medasin 的音乐制作人发布了一段视频，声称他已经弄清楚 Fenix 如何使用人工智能来制作这首歌曲。

它不是 Suno 或 Udio 这两个最著名的音乐制作人工智能工具。 Medasin 表示，Flexin 使用的是一款不太知名的应用程序，名为 Treblo。 梅达辛有条不紊地分解了他的指控：首先，他指出该应用程序在“Rubberz”发布前两天之前一直被称为 Sonauto。 然后他展示了 Fenix 的一个旧 Instagram 故事的屏幕截图，戏弄他的 80 年代新声音。 定格和缩放显示屏幕上显示的文件名具有后缀“Sonauto.mp3”。

但最引人注目的指控是当 Medasin 展示他如何使用 Treblo 创作出非常相似的曲目时。 通过使用“80 年代合成波”等标签并提示应用程序编写有关“说唱歌手生活方式”的歌词，梅达辛获得了一首听起来类似的歌曲。 歌词甚至与《Rubberz》有非常相似之处。

例如，梅达辛的提示让他得到了歌词“钻石链悬挂沉重”； “Rubberz”有“现在我买了一条沉重的钻石链。” 梅达辛生成的歌曲给了他“我在香槟气泡中看到你的脸”；菲尼克斯的歌曲有“仍然在玻璃中看到你的脸”。 这两首歌都以“口袋厚”的一些排列为特色，都提到了“塑料微笑”。

“巧合实在是太多了，”梅达辛在接受《连线》采访时说道。 “他没有使用 Treblo，这在数学上是不可能的。”

不过，这一切都让我感到好奇。 Treblo 会允许我重新创作一首“Rubberz”风格的歌曲吗？ 事实证明：是的。

通过输入“80 年代合成波”等标签并要求它制作说唱歌词，我不仅得到了相似的声音，而且得到了相似的抒情结构。

在我的第一次尝试中，我创作了一首带有对联的歌曲（你可以在这里听到）“每个手指上都有戒指/皮革座椅和雪松香味萦绕”，几乎是“Rubberz”台词“我手指上的金戒指/仍然你的香水挥之不去”的镜像复制品。 我继续创作歌曲。 即使有细微的变化，每当我将“80 年代”标签与“说唱歌词”提示结合起来时，我都会得到类似的结果。

ChatGPT 似乎喜欢妖精、破折号和“这不是 X，这是 Y”结构，而 Treblo 的引擎似乎痴迷于“手指/徘徊”韵律对，谈论戒指、玻璃和口袋，以及从夜晚到白天主题过渡的歌曲结构。

梅达辛说，他的特雷布洛事件发生在一个月前，但他保持沉默。他认为有些记者会为公众做一些将这些点串联起来的跑腿工作。 这种情况确实在较小的规模上发生过，也许最彻底的是在一个名为 Zinstrel 的人工智能音乐新闻网站上，但它从未真正取得突破。 梅达辛的视频最先引起了人们的注意。

随着周四的过去，梅达辛的视频指控似乎触动了人们的神经。 那天下午，菲尼克斯在他的 Instagram 页面上发布了一段视频，他说这是“Rubberz”的原始项目文件。 如果是真的，这将证明这首歌不是人工智能； “Rubberz”是在工作室里从头开始创作的。

但音乐制作人立即发表了评论，许多人声称所显示的项目文件看起来可疑，就像有人刚刚拍摄了一首现有歌曲，并使用“茎分离器”将整首歌曲提取为贝斯和鼓等基本组件；这表明这只是一首他们无法创作的人工智能歌曲。

几个小时后，菲尼克斯删除了该帖子。 自那以后，他和 Purps on the Beat 都没有提及这段“证据”视频，也没有提及该视频被删除的原因。 《连线》杂志向两人发送置评请求，但均未得到答复。

然后，再来一张。 两天后的周六，Medasin 发布了另一个视频，这次声称 Tyga 的新 $TARFACE 项目也至少部分使用了 Treblo。 他从一些松散的联系开始：Tyga 和 Fenix 一起在社交媒体上发布了视频，两者都属于同一厂牌，同样是从说唱歌手到 80 年代歌手的路径。 而且，他还在朋友正在开发的新人工智能音乐检测器中运行了一首 Tyga 歌曲，并且它被标记为人工智能。

但直接听 Treblo 本人的说法更有说服力。

Treblo 联合创始人瑞安·特伦布莱 (Ryan Tremblay) 在被问及置评时表示：“似乎有人使用我们的模型找到了一种让数百万人产生共鸣的声音，这令人兴奋。”

特雷布利表示，特雷布洛此前并未与 Tyga 或 Fenix 进行过交谈，该公司“甚至在进入热门 100 强之前才意识到 [“Rubberz”] 的存在。”

将来可能不需要向 Treblo 询问个别歌曲的情况。 周日深夜，Treblo 发布了一个名为“这是用 Treblo 制作的吗？”的页面。 简而言之，它是一个 Treblo 音乐探测器。 “我们还认为听众应该知道他们听到的是什么，”一篇博客文章解释道，并将其描述为一种“经过调整以检测用 Treblo 制作的歌曲，几乎不需要任何修改”的工具。

果然，将“Rubberz”输入该工具会返回“很可能是 Treblo”的结果。 运行 Tyga 在 7 月初放弃的曲目会返回“可能是 Treblo”的结果。

Treblo 网站称，误报率低于万分之一；百分之几的一小部分。 该探测器的功效尚未经过独立审查，但 Treblo 已根据开源许可证发布了代码，以便任何人都可以检查和测试它。

《连线》杂志向 Tyga 厂牌发出置评请求，但未得到回复。

是否有溢出

所有这一切的时机与平台向人工智能生成内容做出姿态的趋势相吻合。 梅达辛发布第一个视频的同一天，LinkedIn 推出了一项新功能：“看起来像人工智能”按钮，允许用户在帖子中标记人工智能的错误。 两周前，Substack 发布了一项新功能，旨在检测人工智能撰写的时事通讯。 Tidal 阻止了人工智能生成的音乐的货币化，虽然 Spotify 没有人工智能标签功能，但有一个众包跟踪器，你可以在其中向其他听众报告溢出情况。

过去几年图像和视频生成器的激增引发了人们对机器制作内容和错误信息传播的担忧。 美国参议院的两党人工智能标签法案被建议作为部分解决方案：迫使平台对人工智能生成的内容进行明显的标记，以便清楚在线内容是否真实。 “人们应该知道，”一位参议员告诉 Politico。

我们应该预料到会有人不想知道。 如果你破坏了幻想，人们就会生气。

Medasin 第一个视频的评论部分充满了这样的内容：人们说他们无论如何都喜欢“Rubberz”，他们不在乎这首歌是 AI。 人工智能是未来，梅达辛只是嫉妒菲尼克斯首先想到了它。

梅达辛说他对这种反应并不感到惊讶。 他承认，当他第一次听到这首歌时，他就喜欢这首歌，并且仍然以一种讽刺的方式享受它。 “它很吸引人，它在我脑子里盘旋了一个月，”他说。 那么，为什么要冒着一群人看着他的风险，就像他是阴谋委员会模因中的那个人一样呢？

梅达辛说，最终，他认为人工智能在音乐中可以占有一席之地，即使他个人并不喜欢它。 但他希望艺术家说出真相，以便听众可以自己决定。

“这就像音乐史上的一个关键时刻，”梅达辛告诉《连线》杂志，“我对音乐家和人类的旅程以及在音乐中得到庆祝和呈现的人类经历怀有非常非常深的尊重和热爱。” 他谴责任何对此进行欺骗并从中获利的人。 “从精神层面上来说，这对我来说是不道德的，”他说。

乐迷花了大半个夏天的时间争论一首出人意料的热门歌曲是否是合成的。 看来他们已经有了答案。 现在他们只需要决定这对他们有多重要。
